# fux-vt conformance

Every control function ECMA-48 (5th edition, 8.3), DEC STD 070 (its function pages) and xterm's ctlseqs (its headings, patch 411) define, with fux-vt's status, the tests that assert it and why. Rows of fux-vt's own name the modes and protocols a reference leaves in one heading. Generated by `tests/table.rs` from `tests/data/conformance.txt`, whose first four columns `fux-vt-gen catalogue` reads from the references; the test fails when this file, a probe or a named test drifts. The behaviour of each function is in the README.

| Reference | implemented | partial | departure | not implemented | not applicable | all |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| ECMA-48 | 67 | 1 | 3 | 3 | 88 | 162 |
| DEC STD 070 | 86 | 4 | 3 | 22 | 25 | 140 |
| ctlseqs | 107 | 16 | 3 | 27 | 92 | 245 |
| fux-vt | 45 | 2 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 50 |
